# v0.5.0b2 — App startup, automatic discovery and runtime logs

This beta fixes the app startup failure reported as **Invalid or unreadable
service configuration**: Supervisor saves baudrate selections as text, which
the service now accepts for all supported rates.

- Home Assistant discovers the Supervisor app with its address and token.
  No internal hostname or service URL needs to be copied.
- An existing wallbox entry keeps its device/entity IDs and options. A disabled
  entry remains disabled until you enable it again. Repeated discovery creates
  no duplicate entry; a newer announcement replaces stale pending credentials.
- An empty app token is generated once and stored privately. Existing manually
  configured tokens remain valid. Standalone services still use explicit tokens.
- Logs show process/API startup, serial connection, heartbeat start/stop,
  acknowledgement health changes, stop signals and clean shutdown.
- Invalid options name their field. Fatal process failures report the error
  class and errno without credentials. Unexpected worker exits release the
  serial adapter instead of leaving a stalled service behind.

## Update

1. Update the integration to **0.5.0b2** through the Marketplace/HACS beta channel.
2. Refresh the Supervisor app store and update **Mennekes Amtron Modbus Service**
   to **0.5.0b2** from the existing `#apps-beta` repository.
3. Start the app. If the wallbox is not configured yet, confirm the discovered
   entry under **Settings → Devices & services**. Existing working connections
   are retained. See the [handover guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.5.0b2/docs/modbus-service.md)
   when moving from direct serial mode.

The heartbeat is disabled in the app's **Read-only** mode; the log states this
explicitly. Heartbeat health is logged only on changes and adds no per-beat
Recorder history. App data and Supervisor/HA backups contain credentials.

This remains a beta for Supervisor and physical wallbox acceptance testing.
An app/host restart still interrupts heartbeat delivery; an HA Core restart
does not stop the independent service. **v0.4.1 remains the stable release.**
